props.name: description

props.name: errorMessage

props.description: Adds "(optional)" to the label. Use it when most fields in the form are required.

props.name: required
props.description: Deprecated alias of `isRequired`.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Deprecated alias of `isDisabled`.

api.name: FieldLabel

An invalid field sets `aria-invalid` on the control. Messages appear after the control is edited and left, or when the form is submitted, never on the first keystroke.

The required asterisk is hidden from assistive tech; the control carries `required` instead, which screen readers announce.

components.description: A navigation panel that folds to its icons, and moves into a sheet on small screens.

import {
  Sidebar, SidebarCollapseButton, SidebarContent, SidebarFooter, SidebarHeader,
  SidebarInset, SidebarItem, SidebarProvider, SidebarSection, SidebarTrigger,
} from '@/ui/components';

<SidebarProvider persistKey="app-sidebar">
  <Sidebar label="Workspace">
    <SidebarHeader logo={<Logo />} title="Quillo" />
    <SidebarContent>
      <SidebarSection label="Projects">
        <SidebarItem icon="home" href="/" isCurrent>Home</SidebarItem>
        <SidebarItem icon="inbox" href="/inbox" badge={4}>Inbox</SidebarItem>
      </SidebarSection>
    </SidebarContent>
    <SidebarFooter>
      <SidebarCollapseButton />
    </SidebarFooter>
  </Sidebar>
  <SidebarInset>
    <SidebarTrigger />
    <main>…</main>
  </SidebarInset>
</SidebarProvider>

examples.title: Docked

examples.title: Sections and badges

props.name: children

props.name: style

api.description: Reads the nearest SidebarProvider from any component inside it. It returns the fields below and throws outside a provider.

props.name: setCollapsed
props.description: Folds or unfolds the panel.

components.usage: import { Skeleton } from '@/ui/components';

examples.title: Shapes
examples.description: Images, circles, text lines and pills: the placeholders on their own, before any content arrives.

examples.title: Text lines
examples.description: `lines` draws a paragraph: 14px bars on 20px lines, the last one shorter.

examples.title: Width, height and radius
examples.description: Any width and height in px or CSS units, and a radius token or px value.

examples.title: Swap for content
examples.description: Render placeholders in place of the content and mark the container `aria-busy` until it arrives.

examples.title: Reveal content
examples.description: `SkeletonReveal` keeps the real content in layout and grows each bar into it when `ready` turns true.

api.name: Skeleton
api.description: A breathing placeholder in the track color. Hidden from assistive tech.

props.name: shape
props.description: A block or text line, a circle, or a fluid image box with an aspect ratio.

props.name: width
props.description: Width in px or any CSS length. A circle defaults to its `size`.

props.name: height
props.description: Height in px or any CSS length. Without it a rectangle is one 20px text line drawn as a 14px bar.

props.name: radius
props.description: A radius token or px value. Circles are `full`.

props.name: size
props.description: Circle diameter, matching Avatar: 24, 32, 44, 48, 64 or 80 px. The old rectangle presets (`display`, `heading`, `body`, `button`) still work but are deprecated.

props.name: ratio
props.description: Aspect ratio of an `image` placeholder.

props.name: lines
props.description: Draws this many text lines; the last of several is 60% wide.

api.name: SkeletonReveal
api.description: Holds real content in place while placeholder bars cover it, then grows the bars into the content and fades them.

props.name: ready
props.description: Set to true when the content has loaded.

props.name: children
props.description: The real content. It keeps its layout while hidden, so nothing shifts.

props.name: blocks
props.type: { width: number | string; height: number | string; top?: number; radius?: number | string }[]
props.description: Bars over the content box; the radius defaults to `radius-sm`.

props.name: order
props.description: Step in a staged reveal; each step waits `stagger` ms.

props.name: stagger
props.description: Delay between reveal steps in ms.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Stretches the wrapper to its container instead of fitting the content.

accessibility: Placeholders are `aria-hidden`. Set `aria-busy="true"` on the region that is loading and remove it when the content arrives.
If loading takes more than a moment, add a visually hidden status message such as "Loading notes".
SkeletonReveal marks its wrapper `aria-busy` and makes the hidden content `inert` until `ready`, so nothing unseen takes focus.
Under reduced motion the fill stops breathing, and SkeletonReveal only fades.

<Slider label="Volume" defaultValue={40} />

props.name: step

props.description: Help text under the slider.

props.name: style

Without a visible label, pass `aria-label`, or place the slider in a `Field`.
Under reduced motion, the knob does not scale when pressed and the `ticks` ripple is off.

components.description: Show that work is underway.

import { Spinner } from '@/ui/components';

<Spinner label="Syncing files" />

examples.description: `label` shows text beside the ring and names the status for assistive tech.

examples.description: Rings of 16, 24 and 32 px. `md` is the default.

examples.title: Tones
examples.description: `default` draws the arc in the accent, `muted` in secondary text, and `current` follows the color around it.

props.name: closeDelay

accessibility: The tooltip has `role="tooltip"` and is linked to its trigger with `aria-describedby` while it shows.
It opens on hover after `delay` and at once on keyboard focus; Escape and pressing the trigger close it.
A tooltip describes; it never names. An icon-only trigger still needs its own `aria-label`.
Content is text only: people cannot move into a tooltip, so links and buttons belong in a Popover.
Under reduced motion the tooltip fades without moving or scaling.

Parts take the chart palette in order, which is checked for color-vision differences; every part is also named in the legend.

`formatTokens`, `formatCost` and `formatDuration` give every agent number one written form.

radius.note: The one corner every control shares (DESIGN_SPEC 1.3): Button, Toggle, field shells, Badge, Pagination, calendar days. 9999px is the shipped Round shape (every control a pill); a corner ladder sets it equal to radius-md (Tight 6, Standard 10, Soft 14). Tracks and Group shells add their inset to it.

color.note: The one focus ring (spec 1.8). Must stay at least 3:1 against canvas if rethemed.

color.note: The track color: Tabs, ToggleGroup, SegmentedControl connected, icon tiles, keycaps.

color.name: --os-color-bg-elevated

color.name: --os-color-border-control
